source: Kalshi public market data API (api.elections.kalshi.com/trade-api/v2): daily candlesticks, trades and order book
note: Prices are the last trade of each US Eastern trading day, in dollars per $1 contract (0.64 = 64 percent implied chance). big = taker orders of 25,000+ contracts filled in the same second on the same side. taker = contracts bought aggressively on each side per Central time day. book = resting contracts within 3 cents of the price, backing YES (for) and against YES (against).
